correctness.rationale: The repaired RESULT.md proves the actual remaining claim for every n, including n=0. For the parabolic longest idempotent the absent generators' points are fixed, and absorption by each present generator excludes its lowered point from the image. An increasing regressive idempotent retracts every point to its greatest fixed point below it, so these images are a bijection. Two exclusive fixed-point colors in one common gap give unequal compositions; otherwise both compositions retract the gap to its left end. Under complement this condition says each run of I union J belongs entirely to one factor. The separated runs commute, and in each run the full parabolic longest idempotent absorbs the other factor, proving the lift and the union product. Subproducts of commuting idempotents remain commuting idempotents. The transfer keeps exactly the relevant exclusive-side memory in each pair and handles repeated entries. Independently, /workspace/review_evidence/check_1.py constructs the 13 states and their four symmetry classes, obtains the quartic by an exact determinant ratio, and compares against direct Catalan compositions for n=0,...,5. The frozen verifier was inspected, not executed. The quartic remains a checked contextual example, not part of the distinctness claim.

The closest sources give the quotient, classifications, or Catalan-side criteria and refinements, not the 0-Hecke lift. This is a statement-level comparison, not an assertion of historical priority.
residual_risks: The thesis full text was accessible for this review, but the search of its relevant passages is not a proof of global uniqueness. An equivalent lifting result could occur under other semigroup terminology.

value.rationale: The structural identification is worth separating from the numerical overlap: the noninjective quotient loses information on elements in general, yet it retains which idempotents commute and every product of a mutually commuting family. This permits results about the full commuting configurations and their products in either model to be transported to the other, not just equality of a small table. Locating the runwise absorption mechanism supplies the missing reason for that transfer.
